reason: A DeepSeek Harness vision plugin that accepts chat image attachments and adaptively forwards them to native multimodal models or configured vision transcription services.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话添加图片识别能力，可将图片交给原生多模态模型或配置的视觉转写服务处理。
summaries.en: Adds image recognition to DeepSeek Harness conversations by routing images to native multimodal models or configured vision transcription services.

capabilities: routes images to native multimodal models or configured vision transcription providers
sends image data to configured remote endpoints or local Ollama
stores plugin configuration and caches image transcriptions in process
